description: Problem: every decision in the three evaluation rounds rests on Claude models. In the owner's logs the Muse Spark family is the most used in main sessions (about 460 since September) and has never been evaluated; the phase 2 plan notes Muse and Gemini models were not available to the runner. Rules that matter on Claude models may behave differently there, and no skill text may be deleted on Claude-only evidence. Decision gate: ask the owner whether a Muse model can be reached from omp or another supported harness and whether the spend is wanted. If it cannot be reached headlessly, record how that was established and drop the item. If yes, start with a 10-session cost probe; continue only if the projected cost of the keep-rule scenarios (plan-then-proceed and review-then-address for close-out, docs-plain for the writing standard) at 30 per arm is under the ceiling. Guardrails: (1) agents under test run only in /tmp/omp-ablation sandboxes through evals/ablation/run.py, replay.py or the loading-map probe; (2) change nothing under ~/.omp/agent, ~/.claude or ~/.agents while sessions run, upgrade neither omp, Claude Code nor tractable-mcp during a run, and start no run while another evaluation is running; (3) commit the pre-registration (hypothesis, arms, checks, sample, decision, Holm family and alpha) before any scored session; smoke runs never count; (4) use a new out folder and a ledger with the ceiling stated here; stop at the ceiling and report; raising it needs the owner's approval in a later message; (5) record the omp, Claude Code and tractable-mcp versions with the results; never pool new sessions with results from another harness version; new comparisons form their own Holm family and published bands are left unchanged; (6) existing scenarios and pre-registration files are not edited: new arms use new scenario ids and a new pre-registration file, and run.py report or phase3_bands.py over the existing result folders gives the same output before and after; (7) read at least 5 transcripts per arm before reporting any number, and report grader faults found; (8) delete or weaken no instruction or skill text on this evidence; (9) a published number in a report is never rewritten: add a dated note after it; (10) scenario and scratch code that produced a result is committed with it; (11) if a result changes a claim in the blog post 'Testing agent instructions', correct the draft by PR, or if the post is published add a dated correction note and update its 'updated' time; (12) publish by task branch and draft PR with identity Joe Harris <joeharris76@gmail.com>; the item stays open until its PR is merged through the repository's usual flow (green CI, squash merge), and anything this item reserves for the owner is not merged or installed without the owner's message.
